facts.fact: The Electronic Money Regulation 2017 Amendment 2025, issued under the Bank of South Sudan Act 2011 Amendment 2023, has taken effect and applies to licensed financial institutions and non-bank e-money issuers.
The amended regulation licenses non-bank electronic money issuers, requiring standalone payment providers to set up separate companies and obtain regulatory approval with a 65 million SSP filing fee.
